about: Generated by scripts/inventory.mjs from each tool's manifest.json. Do not edit by hand.

tools.name: Agent with Tools
tools.description: Browser-based chat agent that reads/writes files, runs bash commands, and fetches URLs on your local machine via a lightweight Docker bridge. Works with Ollama (offline) or OpenRouter (cloud).

tools.name: Agentic Loop
tools.description: Full LLM tool-calling loop. Define tools, run autonomous tasks, trace every step. Supports Python via Pyodide and VFS file operations.

tools.name: Audio Transcribe
tools.description: Record from the mic OR drag/drop many local audio files (including WhatsApp .opus voice notes), then transcribe each to text using curated OpenRouter audio models — entirely in your browser. Batch queue with per-row status and retry, bundle the session's audio and/or transcripts into a .zip, and optionally send an encrypted share via SG/Send.

tools.name: Chat
tools.description: Multi-turn chat with any LLM. Attach images, PDFs, audio and video files. Maintain conversation history and export transcripts.

tools.name: File Encryptor
tools.description: Encrypt or decrypt any file with AES-256-GCM. Everything stays in your browser. Same encryption used by SG/Send.

tools.name: File Hasher
tools.description: Calculate SHA-256, SHA-1, or SHA-512 hash of any file. Verify file integrity without uploading.

tools.name: Folder Editor
tools.description: Manage VFS folder structures in the browser. Create, rename and delete files and folders. Share via SG/Send. Browse with a live tree view backed by IndexedDB.

tools.name: HEIC Converter
tools.description: Convert a whole Google Photos folder of iPhone HEIC stills + videos into clean WebP/JPEG/PNG/AVIF images, entirely in your browser. Videos become a still frame, Live Photo motion clips are de-duplicated, and all original metadata (incl. GPS) is stripped.

tools.name: Image Tools
tools.description: Convert, resize, crop, redact, and annotate images entirely in your browser. Supports PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF.

tools.name: Infographic Generator
tools.description: Generate infographics from text or documents using image-capable LLM models.

tools.name: Key Generator
tools.description: Create friendly encryption keys like "apple-mango-56" instead of random strings. Visualise entropy and strength.

tools.name: LinkedIn Publisher
tools.description: Publish to LinkedIn from your browser. Phase 0: connection probe. Phase 1+: OAuth + member-mode posting.

tools.name: Live Transcribe
tools.description: A focused, minimal front-end for the audio-transcribe Live mode: one big button to start talking and watch the transcript appear and refine, with the live cost shown. Or drop an audio file to transcribe it. A 'max-simplicity' experience variation that reuses the audio-transcribe JS API and components.

tools.name: LLM Dev Environment
tools.description: Full LLM development environment. Build realities, attach files, inspect requests, track token costs and time-travel through history.

tools.name: Markdown Viewer
tools.description: Open a markdown file and actually read it — headings, tables, code, images and front matter, rendered properly — then print it or save it as a PDF. Drop a file, paste text, or point at a URL. A heading outline for long documents, a raw-source toggle, and page breaks the document itself can ask for. Nothing is uploaded; the file never leaves the tab.

tools.name: Media Probe
tools.description: Drop in a recording and see its structure before you pay a model to guess at it: framewise audio energy with the noise floor and speaking level located, a gap-length histogram that says whether topic-length pauses exist at all, four independent frame-difference metrics, detected scene changes with their evidence, the measured picture-leads-words offset, a filmstrip of what was on screen at each moment (Chrome-profiler style, with a hover playhead and frame preview), and a plan() that proposes where to cut and where to shoot — or refuses. No model calls, no uploads, no cost.

tools.name: Mermaid Diagrams
tools.description: Create, edit and render Mermaid diagrams in your browser. 8 built-in examples cover flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt, mind map and git graph. Live preview, zoom, fullscreen and SVG export.

tools.name: Model Compatibility
tools.description: Static compatibility matrix for LLM models. Tests tool calling, JSON schema, streaming, stop conditions across OpenRouter, Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI.

tools.name: Multi-Agent Chat
tools.description: Chat with multiple specialist agents simultaneously — Architect, Dev, Designer, DevOps, Historian, Librarian. Broadcast to all at once.

tools.name: Narrated Review
tools.description: Narrate a walk through your screen and press a key at each moment that matters — or hand over a recording and let its pauses do the pressing. Either way you get an ordered list of captures (a screenshot, the words about it, and the alignment between them) that becomes a markdown document any AI assistant can read directly. No video is ever recorded live; transcription + screenshot-grounded cleanup via OpenRouter (BYOK), everything in-browser.

tools.name: One-Shot Chat
tools.description: Engineer precision LLM requests. Build system prompts, context blocks, constructed history — send once. No conversation drift.

tools.name: OpenRouter
tools.description: Manage your OpenRouter account. View key stats, spending analytics with charts, model explorer, provisioned key management, and CSV log analysis.

tools.name: SG/Send Theme Explorer
tools.description: Build and preview _page.json layouts with live theme switching, component palette, and viewport simulation. No vault required.

tools.name: PlaybookLM
tools.description: Five-step AI slide deck generator: upload sources, generate strategy, create briefs, generate slide images with version history, export PDF/ZIP/archive or share via SG/Send. Vault-first: every step committed to encrypted vault.

tools.name: Python REPL
tools.description: Interactive Python console in your browser via Pyodide. Install PyPI packages (numpy, pydantic, cryptography) instantly.

tools.name: Send / Receive
tools.description: Send a file, folder, or text via SG/Send and receive it with a token. The JS API primitive for the send/receive workflow — any tool can call sendFile() or drop in <sg-send-drop>.

tools.name: Send Simulator
tools.description: Local SG/Send API simulator for development and testing. Seed test data, inspect requests, simulate vault and file operations without a live server.

tools.name: SG/Send CLI
tools.description: Run sg-send-cli vault operations in your browser. Init, commit, push, inspect — the real Python package from PyPI in WebAssembly.

tools.name: SG Tree Demo
tools.description: Component demo for sg-tree — a reusable tree-view Web Component. Explore props, events, and styling options.

tools.name: SG Video Editor
tools.description: Multi-clip video editor with timeline, preview, and MP4 export.

tools.name: Speed Test
tools.description: Measure upload and download speed to SG/Send infrastructure. Sim mode runs an offline AES-256-GCM crypto benchmark. Live mode measures real network throughput using ChunkedUploader and ChunkedDownloader.

tools.name: SSH Key Generator
tools.description: Generate Ed25519 SSH key pairs entirely in your browser. No server involved. Copy or download your keys instantly.

tools.name: Vault
tools.description: Browse, edit, preview and manage files in an SGraph zero-knowledge encrypted vault. Create new vaults, render markdown/images/JSON/CSV, push/pull sync, and view commit history.

tools.name: Vault Browser
tools.description: Open and browse SG/Send vaults in your browser. Derive keys, decrypt files, view contents — no Python or CLI required.

tools.name: Vault Peek
tools.description: Browse and decrypt vault content entirely in your browser. Enter a vault key or simple token, explore the file tree, and open any file — markdown, images, PDFs, JSON pages — with full trace visibility.

tools.name: Vault (Pyodide)
tools.description: Run Python vault crypto in the browser via CPython/WebAssembly. Compare Python vs JavaScript key derivation side by side.

tools.name: VFS Dev
tools.description: Virtual filesystem developer tool. Test read/write/list/copy/delete operations across memory, IndexedDB and layered providers with live event viewer.

tools.name: VFS Tree Demo
tools.description: Live demo of sg-tree component with VFS integration. Visual directory tree that auto-refreshes on structural changes, with inline file editor.

tools.name: Video Creator
tools.description: Browser-based narrated slideshow creator: upload slides, write narrations, generate Kokoro TTS audio, record with canvas + MediaRecorder, download WebM.

tools.name: Video Publisher
tools.description: One page from recording to YouTube URL: record (or import) a video, extract/route the audio, transcribe via OpenRouter, generate the title/description/tags, review, and upload — the whole pipeline in-browser, blob never leaves the page. Consolidates the video-recorder → video-tools → audio-transcribe → youtube-editor workflow.

tools.name: Video Recorder
tools.description: Browser-based video/audio/screen recorder with 9 capture modes (incl. 2 audio-visualisation modes), camera+screen compositing in three layouts (Landscape PiP, vertical Shorts, and Infographic for tall tabs), and save to SG/Send. Each recording opens in its own tab — drag to compare or reorder.

tools.name: Video Tools
tools.description: Split, trim, and extract audio or video using FFmpeg in your browser. No upload required. Share results via SG/Send.

tools.name: Voice Memo
tools.description: Record, transcribe, and document voice memos locally in your browser. Segment-based audio capture with local Whisper AI transcription. Zero uploads, no server required.

tools.name: WhatsApp Desk
tools.description: Inbox + composer for a Business WhatsApp number on the official Meta Cloud API: conversations as tabs, first-class 24h-window handling (free text inside, approved templates outside), inbound via the whatsapp_relay worker, voice-note transcription (core/sg-transcribe — WhatsApp opus is its headline case), and draft-only AI replies. Demo mode works with zero credentials.

tools.name: YouTube Editor
tools.description: Browser-only YouTube channel companion. Sign in with Google to upload new videos, list your existing uploads, and edit metadata + thumbnails. All API calls go browser→YouTube directly; tokens cached in localStorage (vault swap planned).

tools.name: YouTube Probe
tools.description: A test harness, not a product. Answers the open questions in the talk-miner pack with evidence instead of reasoning: will the API hand back an auto-generated caption track, does talk footage (a moving speaker beside slides) need a region mask, and can a YouTube tab be captured with its audio? Seven offline tests need no token, no network and no clicks; eight manual ones need a Google access token or one gesture.

tools.name: YouTube Upload
tools.description: Browser-only YouTube uploader. Sign in with Google, drop a video, set metadata, and resumable-upload to your channel. Tokens cached in localStorage (vault swap planned).
